headline: Cognizant Closes Acquisition of Digital Engineering Firm Wizeline
summary: Cognizant has completed its purchase of Wizeline to strengthen its AI-native digital engineering and enterprise product development services.
why: Cognizant Technology Solutions is a NASDAQ-listed global provider of IT consulting, cloud services, and enterprise digital architecture.
